title: Bang My Box: The Robin Byrd Story
original_title: Bang My Box: The Robin Byrd Story
plot_overview: A larger-than-life public-access pioneer reflects on her groundbreaking sex-positive call-in show and decades of advocacy for free speech, queer visibility, and safe sex. The documentary explores her distinctive legacy and the private life she kept out of the spotlight.
will_you_like_this: You’ll likely enjoy this if you appreciate candid documentaries about cultural pioneers and overlooked histories; Not for you if you prefer fictional stories or less provocative subject matter.
review_summary: Pros: bold subject; cultural importance; intimate perspective | Cons: limited outside views; potentially provocative; niche appeal
